activity_summary: At four Bartholomew stopped the binding. You had been at it since six, with the dinner hour out of the middle. He sent you home to wash. The stooks stayed with the ground between them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stopped, and did not rearrange the stooks.

entities.name: Bartholomew Hathaway
entities.context: Ended the day, and left the field as it stood.

facets.activity: Stopped binding at four with the stooks still standing
